_about: The 2026 Chicago White Sox, regular season and postseason, from MLB's own published schedule (statsapi.mlb.com, fetched 10/1/26). The regular season (3/26-9/27) is complete: all 162 games with results, first-pitch times converted to Chicago time, TV the Sox's Chicago carrier (CHSN, WCIU, CHSN+) plus any national network, or the national network alone where it was exclusive. Two postponed games (4/2 and 6/11) are stored on the dates they were made up and played (4/3 and 8/20). Postseason: the AL Wild Card Series (won) and the AL Division Series against Cleveland. ALDS start times are MLB's (refreshed 10/8/26: Game 4 at 7pm on 10/8 is being played; Game 5 on 10/10 only if necessary). Later rounds are added when the Sox reach them. The file keeps its old name (tests and docs cite it); it now holds the whole 2026 season.
